title: Overall Failure Rate
text: The overall transaction failure rate is 4.95%, meaning approximately 5 out of every 100 transactions fail. Total failures: 12,376 out of 250,000 transactions.

title: Bank with Highest Failure Rate
text: Among sender banks, Yes Bank records the highest observed failure rate at 5.1% across 24,860 transactions. Note: this is an observed association, not a proven causal relationship. The overall average bank failure rate is 4.96%.

title: Payment Method Failure Rates
text: Transaction type 'Recharge' has the highest failure rate at 5.09% (12,527 transactions), while 'Bill Payment' has the lowest at 4.88% (37,368 transactions).

title: Peak Failure Time Period
text: The 'Early Morning' period shows the highest failure rate at 5.15% (598 failures out of 11,620 transactions). Peak failure hour: 06:00 with 5.4% failure rate.

title: Failure Spike Detection
text: Statistical failure spikes (>rolling_mean + 2×STD) detected on 1 day(s).

title: Transaction Amount & Failure
text: Median transaction amount for successful transactions: INR 628 vs INR 636 for failed transactions (higher by 1.3%). The difference is marginal, though this is a correlation, not a confirmed cause.

title: Device Type Failure Pattern
text: Device 'Web' shows the highest observed failure rate at 5.15% across 12,610 transactions. Device-specific failure differences should trigger compatibility and UX reviews for higher-failure device categories.
